purpose: Posthoc diagnostic of whether the shifted layer-31/32 word-patch sufficiency boundary is carried by block-32 terminal self-attention
system_prompt: Answer the spoken question with the one word the speaker gave. Do not add anything else.
pairs: all eight frozen matched pairs, both reciprocal directions, including any failure
upstream_patch: post-block layer-31 donor residual at nominal word-slot audio-placeholder positions
sublayer_sites: block32.self_attn first output at terminal prompt position
block32.mlp output at terminal prompt position
primary_endpoint: entire answer equals donor word after whitespace and one final punctuation removal, with normal EOS
secondary_endpoint: first-token donor-minus-recipient logit margin where both Titlecase words are single tokens
interpretation_limit: The test is posthoc on already-inspected held-out inputs, so any positive result is mechanistic follow-up, not a new held-out confirmation. Whole sublayer-output swaps do not identify a unique head or prove exclusive normal information flow.
